Deviance residuals

Source: R/residuals.R
residuals.kb_fit.Rd

Posterior point estimates of the deviance residual at each observed row, from the fitted likelihood, matching augment()'s residual column.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'kb_fit'
residuals(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A kb_fit object.

...

These dots are for future extensions and must be empty.

Value

A numeric vector of deviance residuals, length nobs(object).

Details

The deviance residual is computed per draw, then summarised with the posterior median, from the likelihood of the fit's model (see kb_model_describe()). Where the cover calibration has a presence part, the residual combines the deviances of plant presence and biomass and is signed by the difference from the expected biomass.

See also

fitted() for fitted values, and augment().

Other fit methods: augment.kb_fit(), coef.kb_fit(), fitted.kb_fit(), glance.kb_fit(), kb_model_describe(), kb_samples(), kb_stancode(), log_lik.kb_fit(), posterior_epred.kb_fit(), posterior_linpred.kb_fit(), posterior_predict.kb_fit(), prior_summary.kb_fit(), summary.kb_fit(), tidy.kb_fit()

Examples

residuals(fit_weight_sim_nereo)
